words.definition: to go from one place to another, often to a different country
words.example: We like to travel every summer.

words.definition: a place where planes take off and land
words.example: We arrived at the airport early.

words.definition: a small piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place
words.example: I bought two tickets for the train.

words.definition: a large bag that you use to carry clothes when you travel
words.example: I packed my clothes in a suitcase.

words.definition: an official document that shows who you are when you travel to another country
words.example: Don't forget your passport at the airport.

words.definition: a building where people pay to sleep when they are away from home
words.example: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.

words.definition: a drawing of a place that shows roads, cities, and other things
words.example: She used a map to find the hotel.

words.definition: a long vehicle that moves on rails and carries people
words.example: We took a train to the city center.

words.definition: an area of sand next to the sea
words.example: The children played on the beach.

words.definition: a very high hill
words.example: We climbed a small mountain last year.

words.definition: a large town where many people live
words.example: London is a big city.

words.definition: a land with its own people and government
words.example: I want to visit a new country.

words.definition: to reach a place
words.example: We arrived at the hotel at noon.

words.definition: to go away from a place
words.example: Our train leaves at nine o'clock.

words.definition: to arrange to have a room, ticket, or seat before you need it
words.example: We booked a hotel room online.

words.definition: the bags that you take with you when you travel
words.example: I put my luggage on the train.

words.definition: a person who visits a place for pleasure
words.example: Many tourists visit the mountain in summer.

words.definition: in or to a foreign country
words.example: My sister lives abroad now.

words.definition: a journey in a plane
words.example: Our flight was at nine o'clock.

words.definition: a thing that you buy to remember a place you visited
words.example: I bought a souvenir for my grandmother.

text: Last summer, my family and I decided to travel abroad. First, we needed a passport for each person. We went to the airport early because our flight was at nine o'clock. At the airport, we showed our tickets and put our luggage on a big machine. I packed my clothes in a small suitcase. After two hours, we arrived in a beautiful country. From the airport, we took a train to our hotel near the beach. Every day, we walked on the sand and swam in the sea. One day, we visited a big mountain outside the city. We used a map to find the way. Many tourists were there too, taking photos. Before we left the country, we bought a nice souvenir for our grandmother. Our holiday was short, but it was wonderful. We will always remember the beach, the mountain, and the friendly people. Next year, we want to travel to a different country and see new cities. Traveling teaches us about the world and new cultures.
